_note: Defaults for the pool. A repository overrides them with a file of this name at its own root; the script reads that one instead and never merges the two, so an override states the whole policy. Every label name, every rating value, the ordering, the shortlist size, and the accrual, fade and assessment numbers live here, and the script writes no label this file does not name. A few operational bounds -- how many issues and labels a read may return -- are the script's own.

severity.meaning: how bad this is if nothing is done, 4 the worst

urgency.meaning: how soon this needs attention, 4 the soonest

framed.label: framed
framed.meaning: decided work: it is on the board rather than in the pool

cause.label: cause
cause.meaning: observed cause of the issues linked under it as sub-issues; not a task split into parts

assessed.label: assessed:no-cause
assessed.meaning: asked whether it has a cause, and it is its own; an issue never asked carries nothing

_accrual: A cause is at least as bad as the worst thing it produces on the first axis in order, and climbs on the second as they accumulate -- one band per symptoms_per_band, so below that number a symptom moves nothing. Both are read at list time from the sub-issue links; neither is ever written back, so a cause's own labels stay what a person proposed, and an axis nobody rated or rated twice stays that way rather than being filled in from the symptoms.
_fade: The second axis in order falls one band per quiet window, read from the issue's own updatedAt so that nothing has to be stored -- and so that the fade never writes, since a write would reset the very signal quiet is read from. The first axis in order has no decay term, which is why it never falls: with the order shipped here that is severity, and a repository that reorders these axes moves which one decays. At the floor an item is named; it is closed only where closes is true, as not planned, leaving the body and every comment in place so the evidence is kept and the next symptom can reopen it.
_assessment: Most of the pool has never been asked whether it has a cause. The shortlist refuses over an unassessed top so that what it raises are causes, and each cycle names a bounded few more so the backlog is worked through without anyone paying for it at once. before_shortlist is at least 1: the gate is not switchable off from here, and --unassessed is the per-invocation escape.
